title: All you need to know to understand 5G
summary: Physicist Sabine Hossenfelder explains how 5G works and examines the health concerns around millimeter wave radiation. She reviews the scientific evidence and the open letters from scientists.
why: HN recommends it as an even-handed physicist's take for 5G skeptics, noting it is probably safe but under-studied.

quote.text: this is an even-handed (reasonably well-informed) take on the matter from physicist Sabine Hossenfelder
